MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  SEPTEMBER 17, 2024

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
  Estates was called to order at 7:00 p.m. at City of Rolling Hills Estates Council
  Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Dr. N., Rolling Hills Estates, California, by VICE CHAIR
  PERSICHINA.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Pope, Ciarolla, Bain, and Persichina,

  Commissioners Absent:  Johnson, Holdsworth and McCormick

  City Staff Present:  Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  PRESENTATION

  A.  LINDEN H. CHANDLER PRESERVE OVERVIEW

  Cris Sarabia, Conservation Director with the Palos Verdes Peninsula Land
  Conservancy, gave a brief presentation updating the Commission regarding the
  operations at the Linden H. Chandler Preserve.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN asked if residents could plant the types of native plants
  discussed during the presentation at their homes. Mr. Sarabia responded that yes
  as they are native plants to the area and will sustain growth in any of the
  surrounding areas.

  VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA asked if a drip irrigation system was still located at the
  preserve. Mr. Sarabia stated that there is still a drip irrigation system at the
  preserve, but it is only used when necessary during more dry seasons.

  5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  1
SEPTEMBER 17, 2024
   A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF AUGUST
  20, 2024

  Due to a clerical error with the meeting agenda, VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA
  tabled the approval of the August 20, 2024 meeting minutes to the next Park and
  Activities Commission Meeting.

  6.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION PROGRAM FUNDING REQUEST
  FROM DAPPLEGRAY LANES PROPERTY OWNERS’ ASSOCIATION

  Supervisor Pinuelas informed the Commission that the item would need to be
  tabled to a later meeting due to not having a quorum of Commissioners that do not
  reside in the Dapplegray Lanes Property Owners Association present for the item.

  B.  NOVEMBER AND DECEMBER MEETING DATES (VERBAL REPORT)

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief update regarding the November and December
  meeting dates noting that Staff did not foresee any need to adjust or cancel these
  meeting dates and will notify the Commission if any changes are needed.

  COMMISSIONER POPE made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER BAIN to:

  ADJOURN TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD MEETING.

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  **ADJOURNED TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING AT
  7:20 PM**

  C.  HILLS ARE ALIVE RACE DEBRIEF

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief overview of the Hills Are Alive Debrief report (as
  per the agenda material).

  A discussion ensued amongst the Commission and Staff regarding some of the
  considerations presented in the report. The Commission agreed with the
  consideration of changing the date as proposed and possibility to return the 10k
  landfill portion back to the botanical gardens if it made logistical sense without an
  increase in costs.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  2
SEPTEMBER 17, 2024
   Supervisor Pinuelas stated that Staff would reconvene the event subcommittee
  regarding the proposed date change and racecourse change when necessary and
  that Staff may be ready to report back to the Commission when finalizing the event
  dates for the next calendar year with an update regarding the race, in response to
  COMMISSIONER BAIN.

  8.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  TRACY AUSTIN DOUBLES TENNIS TOURNAMENT UPDATE (VERBAL
  REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief update about the 2024 Tracy Austin Doubles
  Tennis Tournament. He briefly went over the current registration numbers,
  marketing efforts and current sponsorships.

  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that it has remained a challenge to obtain sponsorships
  for this event and other City events, but that Staff is still actively pursuing
  sponsorships and is hoping to obtain a couple more prior to the start of the
  tournament, in response to COMMISSIONER POPE.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN suggested Staff look into some of the local family
  foundations as a possible sponsorship opportunity.

  COMMISSIONER POPE made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER BAIN to:

  RECONVENE TO PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING.

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  **RECONVENED PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING AT 7:32 PM**

  B.  GEORGE F. CANYON NEW NATURE CENTER PROJECT UPDATE (VERBAL
  REPORT)

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief update about the George F Canyon New Nature
  Center project. She stated that bids received in the first round came in significantly
  higher than the engineer’s estimate. She explained that due to the higher than
  expected bids, Staff recommended City Council reject the bids and re-bid the
  project with the outdoor classroom and the ramp to the canyon classified as
  additive alternatives. She noted that Council approved Staff’s recommendation
  and that Staff is working to re-bid the project. She added that there are no plans to
  submit a re-design of the project and that Staff would start connecting with potential
  donors as part of the large fundraising campaign and soon develop the smaller
  donation campaign. Lastly she noted that Staff had been in conversations with
  Palos Verdes Peninsula Land Conservancy (PVPLC) regarding closure of the

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  3
SEPTEMBER 17, 2024
   existing Nature Center building due its aging conditions noting that PVPLC staff
  had begun reducing programming due to plans for impending construction and
  select programming would continue as feasible with limited amenities.

  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that the PVPLC has been updated regarding the
  project as it has progressed and is aware the outdoor classroom is now being
  proposed as an additive alternative and while programming specifics had not yet
  been shared with Staff, PVPLC has already been working on alternative ways to
  continue their classes and programs, in response to COMMISSIONER BAIN.

  COMMISSIONER POPE stated that the building will have classroom and exhibit
  space that aligns with their programming and that outdoor classroom was added
  as more of a bonus feature, but the current plans on the new building would be
  able to facilitate the current classes and programs offered by the PVPLC.

  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that the start of construction would begin a few months
  later than anticipated due to the re-bidding of the project and that Staff anticipates
  12-18 months to complete construction, in response to COMMISSIONER BAIN.

  C.  FOUNDERS PARK UPDATE (VERBAL REPORT)

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief update regarding Phase 2 of the Founders Park
  project. She stated that Phase 2 had begun, and that installation of the park
  equipment was pending shipment of the equipment, which was expected to be
  received by the end of September. She stated that it is anticipated the project will
  be completed by the end of October and that a dedication of the park is tentatively
  planned for the fall.

  D.  CITY CELEBRATION PRELIMINARY DEBRIEF (VERBAL REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief update regarding the City Celebration event. He
  went over details regarding the activities offered during the event as well as the
  lunch and beverage services provided during the event. He also noted that Staff
  felt that it appeared to be a wonderful turnout at this year’s event with everyone
  having a great time. He stated that a full debrief report would be presented at the
  next meeting.

  The COMMISSION commended Staff on a great job with a wonderful event. They
  stated that this appeared to be one of the largest turnouts in the past years with
  everyone that attended having a great time throughout the event.

  E.  HOLIDAY PARADE OF LIGHTS UPDATE (VERBAL REPORT)

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  4
SEPTEMBER 17, 2024
   Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief update regarding this year’s annual Holiday
  Parade of Lights. She stated that Staff is again working with Soundskilz who is
  providing parade management services for this year’s event. She also noted that
  Staff was excited to announce Petros Papadakis as the Grand Marshal for the
  parade. She stated that parade unit registration will begin the next week, that the
  pre-parade reception will once again be held at El Polla Inka, and provided
  sponsorship update.

  F.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  10.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF AUGUST 13, 2024

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF AUGUST 20, 2024 SPECIAL MEETING

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  11.  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  A.  ASSESSMENT OF SPACE FOR POTENTIAL DOG PARK AND FUTURE PARKS

  NONE.

  12.  ADJOURNMENT

  VICE CHAIR PERSICHINA ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 7:46 PM TO THE
  NEXT PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON OCTOBER 15,
  2024, AT 7:00 P.M., WHICH WILL BE HELD AT CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT
  CITY HALL.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  5
SEPTEMBER 17, 2024
   There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  __________________________  __________________________
  Matt Morrow  Lou Persichina
  Community Services Coordinator  Vice Chair, Park & Activities
  Commission

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  6
SEPTEMBER 17, 2024
